title: CheckoutEvent (evidence; append-only; sync op visit.checkout, tier T1)

id.description: Client UUIDv7. Idempotency key: resends are duplicates, never conflicts.

visit_id.description: The visit.checkin id this closes. May arrive before or after that op (convergence-safe: linked by id, resolved at read time, never ordered).

fix.description: LOGGED, never gated (ADR-0004) — same doctrine as check-in and attendance.

trigger.description: design 0001 §4: AUTO_GEOFENCE = dwell-matcher-emitted on sustained exit, back-dated to the last-inside fix.

description: Server derives Visit.checked_out_at + duration_minutes at READ time from the earliest matching checkout event (by device_wall_time, id tie-break) — deterministic regardless of arrival order, mirrors km_today/photo_count. The checkin event itself is never mutated.
